messages.subject: plotting grouped stacked barchart in ggplot
parts:
Hi ggplot2 users,

I want to ask that how to do barplots like the figure, with the following data.

There are two groups for each of the three categories (N Ameri, Europe, Asia). In my case, the three categories are month, such as 1, 2, 3. The two groups, one is (p1,p2,p3), the other is (f1,f2,f3) or (g1,g2,g3). When counting together, each bar has 100 in total. The year 2010 should yield such a figure. The year 2011 should yield another figure.

I checked some online help, but still don't know how to do with my case. Thanks for your help.

df
month  year    p1  p2  p3  f1   f2    f3  g1  g2  g3
1         2010    21  20  59  30  32  38  41  10  49
2         2010    30  30  40  28  19  53  18  29  53
3         2010    25  25  50  28  38  34  50  19  31
2         2011    21  20  59  30  32  38  41  10  49
3         2011    30  30  40  28  19  53  18  29  53
4         2011    25  25  50  28  38  34  50  19  31

messages.subject: Re: plotting grouped stacked barchart in ggplot
parts:
Lily, 

You'll need to do some data wrangling first to get it into the right format. 

df <- data.frame(month = rep(1:12, 4), year = rep(2010:2013, each = 12), p1 = sample(1:100, 48, replace=T), p2 = sample(1:100, 48, replace=T) , p3 = sample(1:100, 48, replace=T), f1 = sample(1:100, 48, replace=T), f2 = sample(1:100, 48, replace=T) , f3 = sample(1:100, 48, replace=T), g1 = sample(1:100, 48, replace=T), g2 = sample(1:100, 48, replace=T) ,g3 = sample(1:100, 48, replace=T)  ) 


require(tidyr)
require(dplyr)

p.df <- 
select(df, month, year, starts_with("p")) %>%
gather(., key, value, starts_with("p"))

f.df <- select(df, month, year, starts_with("f")) %>%
gather(., key, value, starts_with("f"))

g.df <- select(df, month, year, starts_with("g")) %>%
gather(., key, value, starts_with("g"))

long.df <- rbind(p.df, f.df, g.df)

require(ggplot2)

ggplot(data = long.df, aes(x =  month, y = value, fill = key)) + geom_bar(stat="identity") + facet_grid(.~ year)

There is probably a way to do the gathering in a single step, but I couldn't get ends_with("1|2|3") to work and the starts_with and ends_with aren't viewable outside of select() nor have help pages. I'll file a github issue for that if I can remember later. 





On Sun, Sep 20, 2015 at 2:58 PM, lily li <choc...@gmail.com> wrote:
p1  p2  p3

Lily, 

You need to do a bit more than just plot here. You need to convert your data to long format multiple times since you have distinct groupings.

parts:
OK, so there's a much simpler way. If your columns end in a number as your example does:

require(tidyr)
require(dplyr)
require(ggplot2)

df <- data.frame(month = rep(1:12, 4), year = rep(2010:2013, each = 12), p1 = sample(1:100, 48, replace=T), p2 = sample(1:100, 48, replace=T) , p3 = sample(1:100, 48, replace=T), f1 = sample(1:100, 48, replace=T), f2 = sample(1:100, 48, replace=T) , f3 = sample(1:100, 48, replace=T), g1 = sample(1:100, 48, replace=T), g2 = sample(1:100, 48, replace=T) ,g3 = sample(1:100, 48, replace=T)  )

long.df <-
df %>%
gather(., key, value, matches("*[0-9]"))
ggplot(data = long.df, aes(x =  month, y = value, fill = key)) + geom_bar(stat="identity") + facet_grid(.~ year)

parts:
Brandon's approach stacks all variables on a bar for each month. If you wanted to dodge the bars by all f's, p's and g's, one way could be the following.

mydf=structure(list(month = c(1L, 2L, 3L, 2L, 3L, 4L), year = c(2010, 
                                                           2010, 2010, 2011, 2011, 2011), p1 = c(21L, 30L, 25L, 21L, 30L, 
                                                                                                 25L), p2 = c(20L, 30L, 25L, 20L, 30L, 25L), p3 = c(59L, 40L, 
                                                                                                                                                    50L, 59L, 40L, 50L), f1 = c(30L, 28L, 28L, 30L, 28L, 28L), f2 = c(32L, 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      19L, 38L, 32L, 19L, 38L), f3 = c(38L, 53L, 34L, 38L, 53L, 34L
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ), g1 = c(41L, 18L, 50L, 41L, 18L, 50L), g2 = c(10L, 29L, 19L, 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      10L, 29L, 19L), g3 = c(49L, 53L, 31L, 49L, 53L, 31L)), .Names = c("month", 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        "year", "p1", "p2", "p3", "f1", "f2", "f3", "g1", "g2", "g3"), class = "data.frame", row.names = c(NA, 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           -6L))
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

longdfp=mydf %>% select(month,year,p1:p3)%>% gather(pvar,pval,p1,p2,p3)
longdff=mydf %>% select(month,year,f1:f3)%>% gather(fvar,fval,f1,f2,f3) 
longdfg=mydf %>% select(month,year,g1:g3) %>% gather(gvar,gval,g1,g2,g3)

ggplot(longdfp,aes(month,pval,fill=pvar,width=.25))+geom_bar(stat="identity")+
  geom_bar(data=longdff,aes(x=month+.25,y=fval,fill=fvar,width=.25),stat="identity")+
  geom_bar(data=longdfg,aes(x=month+.5,y=gval,fill=gvar,width=.25),stat="identity")+
  facet_wrap(~year)+scale_fill_discrete(name="My Vars")
